number.why: The reported POAF risk ratio for colchicine versus placebo is 0.37 with 95% CI 0.21–0.66 in 163 analyzed patients. Agreement applies to the numerical extraction, with the ruling's qualifications: the sources do not establish the served intention-to-treat population or in-hospital/index-admission assessment window. The 14 days describes treatment duration.

quotes.span: The primary outcome was incidence of postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF).
Of 163 analyzed patients (81 colchicine, 82 placebo), POAF incidence was significantly lower in the colchicine group (17.3% vs. 46.3%; RR 0.37, 95% CI 0.21-0.66; p < 0.001)
The regimen included a preoperative loading dose (1 mg twice daily) followed by a weight-based maintenance dose (0.5 mg daily if <70 kg; 1 mg daily if ≥70 kg) for 14 days.

entry.why: Adults scheduled for CABG meet the question's adult cardiac-surgery population. The randomized comparison of perioperative colchicine against placebo addresses the question; unestablished analysis-set and assessment-window labels do not negate this entry-population evidence.

quotes.span: In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 172 adults scheduled for on-pump CABG received colchicine or placebo.
To evaluate the efficacy and safety of short-term, weight-adjusted colchicine initiated preoperatively for preventing postoperative arrhythmias after CABG.

missed: The reason's categorical statement 'which is not ITT' exceeds the evidence. The source says '172 adults scheduled for on-pump CABG received colchicine or placebo' and 'Of 163 analyzed patients (81 colchicine, 82 placebo)' (cache/colchicine-postop-af/records.json#/records/5), without explaining exclusions or defining the analysis set. NOT_STATED, as used in the structured ruling, is supported; definitive non-ITT classification is not. This does not change the numerical extraction or entry ruling.
